basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: A marketing coordination with objectives, audiences, channels and measurement.
Differs from a generic campaign, which may be political, charitable or civic.
Differs from an advertisement or promotion, which is a single creative or offer.
Keeps objective, measurement, attribution and causal effect apart.

may: Plan waves, channels and budgets as drafts.
Check audiences against consent and suppression lists.
mustNot: Target protected groups or infer sensitive attributes.
Claim causal effect from attribution alone.
requiresHuman: Approving audience definitions using personal data.

considerations: Targeting can exploit vulnerable people such as children or people with addictions.
Tracking and profiling intrude on privacy.

items: A campaign names a sponsor, objectives, audiences, channels, a schedule and a budget.
Often confused with an advertisement, a promotion, a communication or a sales opportunity.
